title: Google Ads for Construction Companies - Ruban KT

facts.fact: The page states that Google Ads lets firms start with as little as $15–$30 per day (vendor's own statement, no source cited).
facts.quote: Google Ads offers flexible budgeting, allowing firms to start with as little as $15–$30/day.

facts.fact: The page claims construction clients often see 3–4x return on ad spend within the first three months (vendor claim, no source cited).
facts.quote: Construction clients often see 3–4x return on ad spend (ROAS) within the first three months.

facts.fact: The page states that 40,000+ searches happen on Google per second (unsourced general claim).
facts.quote: 40,000+ searches per second happen on Google, making keyword targeting critical.

facts.fact: The page states that construction companies using Google Search Ads often see conversion rates of 8–12% (vendor claim, no source cited).
facts.quote: Construction companies using Google Search Ads often see conversion rates of 8–12%.

facts.fact: The page states that the Google Display Network gives access to over 35 million websites and apps (unsourced).
facts.quote: Access to over 35 million websites and apps.

facts.fact: The page claims display ads can increase brand awareness by up to 80% (vendor claim, no source cited).
facts.quote: Display ads can increase brand awareness by up to 80%.

facts.fact: The page claims Local Services Ads can generate 2.5x higher quality traffic than traditional search ads (vendor claim, no source cited).
facts.quote: LSAs can generate 2.5x higher quality traffic than traditional search ads.

facts.fact: The page states that businesses with Local Services Ads often see a cost-per-lead between $100 and $300, depending on competition (vendor claim, no source cited).
facts.quote: Businesses with LSAs often see a cost-per-lead between $100–$300, depending on competition.

facts.fact: The page states that YouTube reaches over 2 billion logged-in users monthly (unsourced).
facts.quote: YouTube reaches over 2 billion logged-in users monthly.

facts.fact: The page claims video ads can increase purchase intent by up to 97% when paired with remarketing (vendor claim, no source cited).
facts.quote: Video ads can increase purchase intent by up to 97% when paired with remarketing.
By [Ruban KT](https://www.rubankt.com/author/ruban/ "View all posts by Ruban KT") / August 1, 2025
